cursor.description: Opaque continuation with the same connection and status.

FunctionInput_justworks_listtimeoffpolic.description: Page size, continuation, and optional status filter for connected-company time off policies.

type.description: Provider policy classification such as vacation.

items.description: A time off policy with its provider lifecycle and calendar dates.
One page of policies in provider order.

FunctionOutput_justworks_listtimeoffpoli.description: One page of connected-company time off policies and an optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use to discover policy IDs for `list-time-off-requests` and `create-time-off-balance-report`. Continue with nextCursor as cursor using the same status. Limit is 1–100, default 100.

functions.name: list-time-off-requests
functions.description: List one page of time off requests by date range, optionally filtered by member, policy, or status.

limit.description: Maximum requests in this page, default 100.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same connection and filters.

endDate.description: Provider date-range end, on or after startDate.

startDate.description: Provider date-range start; request-overlap and boundary inclusivity are not documented.

FunctionInput_justworks_listtimeoffreque.description: Calendar-date range and optional filters for one page of time off requests.

amount.description: Requested quantity in unitType units, not an instant or monetary amount.

unitType.description: Provider quantity unit, such as minutes; retained without conversion.

createdAt.description: Creation instant normalized to UTC preserving precision.

updatedAt.description: Update instant normalized to UTC preserving precision.

privateReviewNote.description: Sensitive internal reviewer note, when returned.

items.description: A matching time off request with provider quantities and separate review-note visibility classes.
One provider page of matching time off requests.

FunctionOutput_justworks_listtimeoffrequ.description: One page of time off requests and an optional continuation cursor.

tags.instructions: Use calendar dates and optional IDs from `list-members` and `list-time-off-policies`. Pass nextCursor as cursor with unchanged filters to continue. Limit is 1–100, default 100. Amount uses the returned unitType; do not assume hours. Review notes may contain sensitive internal information.

functions.name: revoke-oauth-token
functions.description: Revoke a supplied access or refresh token issued to the configured OAuth application.

token.description: Sensitive access or refresh token to revoke for the configured application.

tokenType.description: Optional provider token-type hint; omitted means provider best-effort lookup of both types.

FunctionInput_justworks_revokeoauthtoken.description: The exact OAuth token to revoke and an optional token-type hint.

accepted.description: Justworks acknowledged the revocation request; does not prove a token previously existed or that related tokens were revoked.

FunctionOutput_justworks_revokeoauthtoke.description: Acknowledgement of the supplied token revocation request.

tags.instructions: Use for OAuth application security administration or explicit token revocation, not ordinary data reads. Supply the sensitive token and preferably its type. Revocation prevents further use of the token; obtaining access again may require authorization. Do not assume revoking one token revokes every related token.

functions.name: update-deduction
functions.description: Replace one deduction's editable configuration while retaining its identity and member association.

description.description: Complete replacement description; empty explicitly clears it if supported.

amountType.description: Fixed uses major currency units; percentage uses percentage points.

amount.description: Exact nonnegative replacement amount; fixed allows two fractional digits, percentage four.

endDate.description: Replacement end calendar date; null requests no end date, subject to validation of provider clearing support.

FunctionInput_justworks_updatededuction.description: Complete editable replacement configuration for one existing deduction.

success.description: Provider success flag, preserved without interpreting conflicting messages.

memberId.description: Provider-returned member identifier; association is not changed by this tool.

errorMessage.description: Provider item diagnostic, omitted when absent.

FunctionOutput_justworks_updatededuction.description: The single provider update result, including any diagnostic alongside its success flag.

tags.instructions: Obtain the deduction ID and current settings from `list-deductions`. Supply the complete editable configuration; this is replacement, not a sparse patch. Use `cancel-deduction` to stop a deduction and `batch-update-deductions` for up to 25 replacements. Amounts use major currency units or percentage points. Check all returned diagnostics.
